3581.title: Desktop packaging omits npm dependencies
3581.rootCauseOneLine: The pnpm collector omits npm bundled dependencies and the package copier excludes nested node_modules.
3581.proposedFix: Preserve the npm bundled dependency tree during desktop packaging and smoke-test the packaged CLI.
3581.caveats: Tested collector/copier output twice, not the signed release or plugin update; current main is missing 60 of 65 top-level dependencies, not the reported release count of 58.
